era: 2019 aa.com (the 2016 design used through 2019): white header with the American Airlines logo, Log in, language and region picker, search, and Plan Travel / Travel Information / AAdvantage menus in light blue; the home booking box with Book, Your trips / Check in and Flight status tabs; News and offers slideshow; Help / About American / Extras footer. Arquivo.pt captures from March, September and November 2019 agree. Checked live read-only in the user's Chrome (aa.com blocks headless browsers); the header and footer are inside adc-header / adc-footer shadow roots, which the inventory does not read, so they were listed by hand.
